title: Exposure of Langfuse API keys in team exception handling due to missing team_id in error response
cwe: CWE-1230: Exposure of Sensitive Information Through Metadata
trigger_payload:
Use these settings:

litellm_settings:
  telemetry: False
  drop_params: True
  return_response_headers: True
  redact_messages_in_exceptions: True
  cache: True
  cache_params:
    type: s3
    s3_bucket_name: os.environ/CACHING_S3_BUCKET_NAME
    s3_region_name: os.environ/CACHING_AWS_DEFAULT_REGION
    s3_aws_access_key_id: os.environ/CACHING_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
    s3_aws_secret_access_key: os.environ/CACHING_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
    s3_endpoint_url: os.environ/CACHING_AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3
  failure_callback: ["sentry", "langfuse"]
  request_timeout: 3600
  success_callback: ["langfuse", "s3"]
  s3_callback_params:
    s3_bucket_name: os.environ/LOGGING_S3_BUCKET_NAME
    s3_region_name: os.environ/LOGGING_AWS_DEFAULT_REGION
    s3_aws_access_key_id: os.environ/LOGGING_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
    s3_aws_secret_access_key: os.environ/LOGGING_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
    s3_endpoint_url: os.environ/LOGGING_AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3
  default_team_settings:
    - team_id: test_dev
      success_callback: ["langfuse", "s3"]
      langfuse_secret: os.environ/LANGFUSE_PRIVATE_KEY_TEST
      langfuse_public_key: os.environ/LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY_TEST
    - team_id: my_workflows
      success_callback: ["langfuse", "s3"]
      langfuse_secret: os.environ/LANGFUSE_PRIVATE_KEY_WORKFLOWS
      langfuse_public_key: os.environ/LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY_WORKFLOWS
Then send a completion request with an API key from the my_workflows team.
oracle: Error response contains Langfuse secret and public key, leading to exposure of sensitive information
